title: Repair ticket: a divider that reads wrong
brief: A divider on a returned board reads wrong. One fault is hidden in it: the drawing shows the circuit as designed, and the meter reads the board as it is. Measure with the power on (V to ground, V between, or a part's current), then name the fault. A good technician splits the suspects in half with each reading; the budget is the worst case of that route over every suspect, plus two.

spec.note: A call no reading with the power on can tell from the hidden fault counts as right.

spec.how: Each distinct probe placement counts once; reading the same place again is free.
